from zinnia import *

import numpy as np

@zk_circuit
def harris(I: Float[Array, 'N<=1024 M<=1024']):
    m, n = I.shape
    dx = (I[1:, :] - I[:m - 1, :])[:, 1:]
    dy = (I[:, 1:] - I[:, :n - 1])[1:, :]
    A = dx * dx
    B = dy * dy
    C = dx * dy
    tr = A + B
    det = A * B - C * C
    k = 0.05
    return det - k * tr * tr
